description: Behind Astro Code Blue are three curious minds, brought together by a shared interest in space, technology and the excitement of creating something new. We may not be experts in astronaut healthcare or space science, but we are eager learners with big ideas and a willingness to explore. With teamwork, creativity and a little courage to step beyond what we already know, we set out to build something meaningful.
summary: For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we didn't just created a health monitoring system; we developed an interactive visual tool designed to support astronauts during both current and future space missions. During spaceflight, microgravity and other space-related conditions can affect different parts of the human body, creating health challenges that need continuous attention. Through Astro Code Blue, astronauts can manually enter their health readings, such as heart rate, oxygen level and bone density, assess their health conditions and receive alerts when unusual variations are detected. But that's only the beginning! With our 3D Body Explorer, astronauts can explore different organs, understand their normal functions, discover possible spaceflight-related effects, and learn about associated hazards through NASA research and preventive guidance. Our platform also includes Health Trends to track changes over time, Health Guidance to support informed health decisions, and interactive Mission Tasks that turn daily wellness activities into engaging challenges. From the Overview dashboard to Health Assessment, 3D Body Explorer, Health Trends, Guidance, Mission Tasks and Settings, every section contributes to one mission: Monitor, Understand and Maintain Astronaut Health.
details:
ASTRO CODE BLUE

Intelligent Astronaut Health Assessment and Space-Medicine Decision Support Platform

1. Introduction

Astro Code Blue is an interactive astronaut health assessment and decision-support tool designed to address the physiological and medical challenges associated with human spaceflight. Space environments, particularly microgravity, can significantly affect the human body, leading to changes in bone density, muscle strength, cardiovascular function, vision, balance, sleep patterns, and mental well-being.

Our project aims to make astronaut health monitoring more accessible, understandable, and interactive by combining structured health assessments, 3D anatomical exploration, health data visualization, and AI-assisted, research-based medical guidance.

Rather than presenting health information as isolated measurements, ASTRO CODE BLUE provides a unified visual environment where users can enter health information, explore affected body systems, understand changes over time, and access relevant medical knowledge.

The platform is primarily designed for astronauts, flight surgeons, space-mission medical officers, and researchers working in astronaut health and human spaceflight.

2. Core Features and Application Modules

1. Health Assessment Portal :
- Multi-category input collecting biometric, lifestyle, and environmental metrics.
- Real-time submission triggers dual analysis (Kaggle AI + local validation).
- Generates flight surgeon alert status (Nominal, Caution, Critical).

2. 3D Anatomical Body Explorer :
- Interactive Three.js 3D astronaut rendering.
- Visual mapping of physiological systems: Cardiovascular, Neuro-Ocular,
Musculoskeletal, and Respiratory response to microgravity.

3. Health Trends & Time-Series Analytics :
- 24-hour, 7-day, 30-day, and all-time longitudinal trajectory analysis.
- Monitors cardiac adaptation, fluid shifts, and cumulative sleep deficits.

4. Medical Tasks & Countermeasures :
- Tracks 5 countermeasure protocols:
* ARED Heavy Resistance (prevents bone mineral density loss)
* T2 Treadmill (aerobic conditioning & impact loading)
* CEVIS Cycling (vascular distribution)
* Chibis LBNP (Lower Body Negative Pressure for SANS optic decompression)
* Columbus Sensorimotor (neuro-vestibular recalibration)

5. Tele-Triage AI Support :
- Interactive medical support chat.
- Retains conversation memory across turns.
- Direct live access to `astro_code_blue.db` database telemetry.
- Automatic escalation to Ground Flight Surgeon if critical symptoms occur.

6. Ground Control Admin Console :
- Full flight surgeon telemetry view.
- Permanent chat summary records: even if crew members delete chats locally,
the clinical summary and recommendations are permanently audited here.

The purpose is to encourage astronauts to follow regular health-maintenance activities and support their overall well-being during extended missions.


3. System Architecture and Technology

Astro Code Blue combines a modern web-based frontend with a dedicated backend to support interactive health assessment and data management.

FRONTEND:
- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router) with React 19
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, Custom Space Theming (Inter, Intel One Mono fonts)
- 3D Graphics: Three.js (interactive astronaut model loader)
- Data Visualization: Recharts (multi-axis physiological time-series)
- Architecture: Server Components & Client Component optimization

BACKEND:
- Framework: FastAPI (high-performance Python ASGI)
- Server: Uvicorn with standard workers
- Database: SQLite with SQLAlchemy ORM
- Data Engineering: Pandas & NumPy for time-series trend calculation
- Validation: Pydantic v2 schemas
- Embedded Node SQLite: `node:sqlite` for direct real-time database queries

ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE & MACHINE LEARNING:
- Large Language Model: Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct (Alibaba Cloud / Hugging Face)
- Frameworks: PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Accelerate
- Inference Engine: FP16 precision on Cloud GPU (Kaggle T4 / P100)
- Tunneling: Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) for secure, zero-config GPU streaming
- Dual Endpoint Design:
* `/analyze` — Structured clinical JSON schema generation
* `/chat` — Low-latency tele-triage conversational assistant

SECURITY & AUTHENTICATION:
- Next.js Edge Middleware for protected routes (`/admin/*`)
- HTTP-Only secure session cookies
- Environment-based credential configuration

The architecture is designed to bring together interactive visualization, structured health information, persistent assessment records, and research-based guidance in one platform.

4.How Does Astro Code Blue Work?

Astro Code Blue follows a structured workflow that integrates astronaut health-data collection, processing, visualization, anatomical exploration, and research-based medical information.

1. Crew Member Assessment:
The astronaut submits physiological data through 6 clinical categories:
Vitals (HR, BP, SpO2, Temp), Sleep & Hydration, Cognitive Wellness,
Vision & Symptoms (SANS), Space Environment (CO2, Radiation), and
Specialized Medical inputs.

2. Dual-Engine Clinical Evaluation:
- Tier 1 (Online): Telemetry is sent to the Kaggle GPU model (Qwen 2.5 7B).
The model analyzes multivariate correlations and generates an overall
clinical health assessment, flight surgeon alert severity, and tailored
exercise prescriptions.
- Tier 2 (Offline Fallback): If deep space communication is severed or
Kaggle is unreachable, the local Python clinical rule engine takes over
instantly. Zero interruption in crew care.

3. Tele-Triage & Clinical Support Chat:
Astronauts converse with an AI Medical Officer with full contextual memory.
The AI reads directly from the astronaut's active SQLite medical database
to discuss real-time vitals, hydration deficits, or SANS symptoms.

4. Ground Control Permanent Audit:
Ground surgeons access `/admin` to monitor orbital telemetry. To protect
mission integrity, whenever an astronaut deletes a chat session in space,
the full clinical summary, triage level, and recommendations are permanently
archived and preserved for Ground Control review.

5. Target Users and Beneficiaries

Astronauts: Can enter health information, understand spaceflight-related physiological changes, explore their body systems, and follow preventive health practices.

Flight Surgeons and Medical Officers: Can review astronaut assessment information and use the platform as an additional health-information and decision-support resource.

Space Researchers: Can explore the relationship between spaceflight conditions and human physiological changes through structured information and anatomical visualization.

Space Agencies and Mission Planners: Can use the platform as a conceptual foundation for more accessible astronaut health-monitoring and decision-support systems.

6. Expected Impact

Astro Code Blue aims to contribute to safer and more informed human space exploration by improving how astronaut health information is collected, visualized, and understood.

Its key expected contributions include:

  • Improved Health Awareness: Making complex physiological changes during spaceflight easier for astronauts to understand.
  • Interactive Medical Education: Using 3D anatomical visualization to connect human body systems with spaceflight-related health challenges.
  • Continuous Health Monitoring: Supporting the review and comparison of health assessment records over time.
  • Research Accessibility: Connecting astronaut health concerns with relevant NASA research and medical reference materials.
  • Preventive Healthcare: Encouraging consistent health-maintenance activities and awareness of potential medical concerns.
  • Decision Support: Bringing health assessments, anatomical information, historical trends, and research-based guidance together in a unified platform.

7. Conclusion

Astro Code Blue is an effort to make astronaut healthcare more interactive, accessible, and research-oriented.

By combining a structured health assessment system, an interactive 3D Astronaut Explorer, health trend visualization, persistent health records, and guidance the platform provides a unified approach to understanding and monitoring human health in space.

As human space exploration advances towards longer-duration missions and deeper-space travel, maintaining astronaut health becomes increasingly important. Astro Code Blue aims to support this goal by transforming complex space-medicine information into an accessible visual and interactive health-assessment experience.
